resolve_rule: each base flat modifier multiplied by rarity multiplier then floor; add slot sources separately once; no random substats

fusion.output: same definition/tier, next rarity; new instance ID

starter_grants.rule_source: D-059 user request 2026-10-20: characters start with no equipment
starter_grants.acquisition: Story/farm drops and the targeted training weapon purchase
starter_grants.previous_baseline: TASK-009 common tier 1 six-piece set per character creation (replaced)

targeted_weapon_purchase.purpose: cheap Class2 entry weapon only; cannot shortcut rarity/tier/ore progression

random_options.rule_source: D-062 user request 2026-10-20 (Rare 1 line, Epic 2 lines); other counts, pool and ranges are an assistant baseline to tune in TASK-041
random_options.value_rule: value = (min + (max - min) * roll / roll_scale) * tier_scale[item tier], rounded to 4 decimals; tier up keeps rolls so values grow, fusion rolls fresh lines

build_impact_note: D-103: authored role modifiers and two damage options; old rolls, base stats, rarity, costs and ownership unchanged. Trial balance, not PCRO values.
